message: １０万兆億不可思議

name: Sally
message: 「Soba♪ Soba♪ Hurry up and serve it♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Feed us already!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, just a little longer」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And with this...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here! Thanks for waiting!」

name: Sally
message: 「Digging in! So damn good!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kuhaa, this hits the spot!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the meal. Sorry to always trouble you like this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no, I just do it 'cause I like it. Let's eat!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, so」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「How did it go? Did you get along okay with Senior Misasagi?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The worst」

name: Sally
message: 「Gwah! Kuhaa, the worst! Waaah, waaah」

name: Paqy
message: 「You put in way too much wasabi」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't make progress on your assignment, huh. Then--」
I was about to ask if I should get Helena-san to make me your supervisor, when.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just listen to this, Synn! That Bubuzuke jerk just assumed I wouldn't be able to do any of it! So pisses me off!」
I see. So she provoked her into doing it.
Not bad, Senior Misasagi--she really gets Nanaka's personality.

name: Nanaka
message: 「So I solved 'em all in a flash!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then, she had the nerve to go, 'A problem of this level, I could solve in half the time, you know'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Keep at it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah! Next time for sure, I'm gonna show her what's what!」
If it had been me, I probably wouldn't have been able to handle it like that.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still... I wanted to do it with you, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Nothing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh. Ugh, I hate this. More bubuzuke and assignments today too, huh. I bet that guy is the reason I had such a bad dream this morning」

name: Synn
message: 「Dream?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's no big deal, really. I've just been having weird dreams lately」

name: Synn
message: 「Weird how?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So there's a mirror, right, and I'm reflected in it」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be creepy if something else was reflected in it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha. Fair point. Anyway, the face looks just like me, except it's not me」

name: Synn
message: 「In what way?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Umm... somewhere on the face, I guess. It's a tiny difference, yet it completely changes the whole impression... hmm」

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't really sound like a bad dream to me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not bad, exactly... more like feeling out of place as a version of me that isn't me, or just feeling grossed out--」

name: Sally
message: 「Phew, that was delicious! Seconds!」

name: Paqy
message: 「For the great me, too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah」

name: Sally
message: 「I love you, Nanaka!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what about the dream?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. Well, never mind. Hearing about someone else's dream is boring anyway, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Not really. Especially since I don't have dreams like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, 'cause you sleep good, poop good, and eat good, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the exact same way, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Compared to you, I'm plenty delicate, I'll have ya know」

name: Shio
message: 「Members of the Student Council! I am deeply disappointed in you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio! You mustn't run in the hallways」

name: Shio
message: 「Older Sister! Have you no shame?! Have you no shame as a human being?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Could you at least explain what's going on?」

name: Shio
message: 「Have you all not been making sport of a helpless young girl?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Setting Sakura-kun aside, the rest of us haven't been doing anything of the sort」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't been doing that either!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no way Synn would do something like that. Besides, I don't even have the free time for that kind of thing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you would do it if you had the free time, Treasurer. How distasteful」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell I would!」

name: Shio
message: 「You dare feign ignorance?! How despicable, even at this stage!」

name: Ria
message: 「Shio-chan. Who is saying such things?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh! The accusation was so utterly shocking that I completely forgot to ask the informant's name」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't know their name... was it an outsider?」

name: Ria
message: 「A parent or guardian, perhaps?」

name: Misa
message: 「Did they look familiar?」

name: Shio
message: 「No, I have no recollection of them whatsoever」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't just blindly believe the testimony of someone whose face and name you don't even know」

name: Shio
message: 「How careless of me! Curse them! To think they would deceive me!」

name: Misa
message: 「This isn't even on the level of being deceived」

name: Synn
message: 「Where is that person now?」

name: Arden
message: 「It's me! My name is Arden! Chief of the Seven Demon Generals! And Pasta-chan's (soon-to-be) husband!」

name: Shio
message: 「Everyone, why do you look upon me with eyes meant for a suspicious character」

name: Misa
message: 「Our opponent is a Demon General. And on top of that, someone connected to them... To swallow that whole...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hauu. What a repeated blunder! Having come to this, I shall slice open my belly as an apology!」

name: Arden
message: 「Listen up to the great me, the Chief of the Seven Demon Generals!」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't the Chief of the Seven Demon Generals Bylous?」

name: Arden
message: 「Hmph. That little brat. He can't even hold a candle to me! The great me is a hundred thousand trillion hundred million fukashigi times stronger!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That actually makes you sound weaker」

name: Arden
message: 「Whaaat!? Are you mocking me knowing I can't count!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget that, you're just 'planning to become' one?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you are not one right now. Things like that are usually just the person's own delusion」

name: Misa
message: 「A textbook delusional guy. Could he be a stalker?」

name: Arden
message: 「Sh-Shut up! Y-You hit a sore spot! The great me is furious! No more talk, step outside!」

name: Arden
message: 「I'll praise you for coming without running away! But weep when you see the great me's power!」

name: Arden
message: 「Gogogogogogogogogogo!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「! Ah... what... is this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's nothing... it's nothing at all...」

name: Synn
message: 「But your face looks--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can fight!」

name: Arden
message: 「Fuhahaha. Are you terrified of the great me's power! The great me is awesome!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Honestly, it is disappointing for how flashy it is. Compared to the two from earlier, it is like the moon and a stew pot」

name: Misa
message: 「That's certainly true. Though it's 'mud turtle,' not 'stew pot'」

name: Arden
message: 「Nufuu! If you're going to make a fool out of the great me that much, you'd better be prepared!」
Nanaka is acting strange. Is she afraid of Arden?
I don't think that's it, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, fall back!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, everyone!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Answer me, Angel!? Why!? Why only me!?」
